name: run-usage
title: Run Usage
description: What one agent run used: a chip under the answer (steps, context, cache, optional money), a panel by model with cache per step and Subagents, and a table with one row per model call.

meta.whenToUse: Show what an agent run used: the chip under an answer, the panel in a run drawer, the table of model calls for maintainers and admins.
meta.whenNotToUse: Workspace-wide spend over time (a chart) or a single context gauge in the composer (ContextRing).
